messages:
morgan: Spike: how do we safely hotplug a new model variant for very large checkpoints without blocking traffic? thinking progressive layer warmup + streaming handoff.

sasha: Love progressive layers. Idea: manifest includes ordered layer groups + "ready_threshold" per group. Node can flip active pointer once critical groups warm.

tonY: Filesystem reality: no atomic cross-volume rename. Do control-plane publish of bundle-hash and let node perform RCU pointer swap after validating local files.

emily: Key: do not restart processes. Loader must handle live manifest updates and maintain two live handles during handoff: active and candidate. Switch atomically in-memory.

morgan: How to avoid mixing parameter variants during long-running streaming responses?

sasha: Strategy: pin request to variant hash at start of request. New requests can be routed to candidate when node marks candidate as ACCEPTABLE. Streaming continues on pinned handle.

tonY: Implementation: add request-scoped variant header. Loader exposes tidily: get_active_handle(), get_handle_for_request(request_id). When swapping, new get_active_handle() returns candidate; existing handles drain.

emily: Warmup gating: two signals: prefetch hit-rate on hot KV pages and a small probe suite (synthetic inferences). Config in manifest: min_hit_rate, probe_samples, max_warmup_secs, fallback_hash.

morgan: Example manifest warmup block: {"min_hit_rate":"0.65","probe_samples":"50","max_warmup_secs":"90","fallback":"prev123"} — nodes should only mark ACCEPTABLE if either probes pass or TTL expires.

sasha: Cache policy: tag prefix cache with bundle_hash instead of global invalidate. Tagging makes per-variant cache isolation cheap.

tonY: For very large models, support staged activation: mark layers 0..k ACTIVE while remaining layers are in WARMING state. Runtime should handle missing layers by blocking just-in-time read with backpressure, or route to fallback for those requests.

emily: Backpressure rules: if a request needs non-ready layer, either queue (short window) or 5xx fallback depending on SLO. Make this a policy in manifest: on_missing_layer -> {queue_seconds, fallback}.

morgan: Transcode: prefer producing common quant variants at upload time. For uncommon variants, allow lazy transcode as async background job and advertise bundle as "partial" until finished. Node must not activate a partial bundle unless warmup satisfied.

sasha: Storage layout: immutable /srv/weights/<bundle_hash>/layerN.safetensors. Manifest enumerates layers, checksums, and order. GC via bundle refcounts.

tonY: Rollout: tiny canary -> traffic ramp -> automated health checks (p99 latency, oom count, error-rate, and sample-quality). Add auto-revert threshold.

emily: Add an endpoint: /bundle/{hash}/lease to query node lease state, warmup progress, and remaining TTL. Helps control-plane decide routing.

morgan: Action items: Tony to draft a minimal manifest schema with warmup+on_missing_layer policy and loader API for handle swap + lease endpoint. Sasha to prototype cache-tagging. Emily to add request pin header to routing layer.

ops-bot: Note added to runbook "progressive-hotplug".

morgan: OK saving this thread as the follow-up record for progressive hotplug handoff decisions.
